name: Suiren Yomi
source:
Hasumi's younger sister. She is quiet, lacking in self-confidence, and frequently abused by her older sister.

Perhaps because of this trauma, she has become a girl who cannot speak very clearly. She loves her family, but she is always being yelled at for not being able to express her feelings well.

[translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/11/10/rain/]official website[/url]]
